name: solid-gemc-claude
description: Build, run, and analyze solid_gemc (SoLID experiment) simulations from natural language. The orchestrator skill drives the full flow through bin/solid-gemc-run: JLabCE 2.5 container pulled via wget, tcsh runtime inside the container, host-side analysis with uproot. Same repo as the Claude Code plugin; this manifest is the Codex CLI surface.

interface.shortDescription: Run SoLID experiment (solid_gemc) simulations from natural language: container-based gemc + host-side uproot analysis.
